nominal-gdp.def: GDP measured at the prices of the year the output is produced, so it rises when prices rise even if output does not.

real-gdp.def: GDP measured at base-year prices, so it changes only when the quantity of goods and services produced changes. Real GDP = nominal GDP divided by the GDP deflator, times 100.

gdp-deflator.def: A price index for all final goods and services produced in a country: nominal GDP divided by real GDP, times 100. It is 100 in the base year.

growth-rate.def: The percent change in real GDP from one period to the next: (new minus old) divided by old, times 100.
